tools.name: import_scans
tools.description: Import security scan results into DefectDojo. Actions: 'import_scan' (upload new scan to engagement), 'reimport_scan' (update existing test with new scan results), 'import_endpoint_meta' (bulk endpoint metadata import), 'import_languages' (import language statistics).

scan_type.description: Scanner name (e.g. 'ZAP Scan', 'Burp Scan', 'Nessus Scan', 'Trivy Operator Scan')

engagement.description: Engagement ID to import into (required when not using auto_create_context)

test.description: Test ID to reimport into (required when not using auto_create_context)

auto_create_context.description: Auto-create product/engagement/test if they don't exist

deduplication_on_engagement.description: Deduplicate findings within engagement scope only

minimum_severity.description: Minimum severity to import: Critical, High, Medium, Low, Info

do_not_reactivate.description: Do not reactivate mitigated findings found again (reimport)
